title: feat: implement enterprise-grade features (roadmap 2.4)
body:
Implements all four enterprise-grade features from roadmap section 2.4: Advanced Grid, Reporting Engine, Workflow Engine, and AI Integration.

## New type definitions (`@object-ui/types`)

- **`workflow.ts`** — 13 types: `WorkflowSchema`, `WorkflowNode`, `WorkflowEdge`, `WorkflowDesignerSchema`, `ApprovalProcessSchema`, `ApprovalRule`, `WorkflowInstanceSchema`, etc.
- **`ai.ts`** — 10 types: `AIFormAssistSchema`, `AIRecommendationsSchema`, `NLQuerySchema`, `AIInsightsSchema`, `AIConfig`, `AIFieldSuggestion`, etc.

## Advanced Grid (`plugin-aggrid`)

- `TreeDataConfig` — hierarchy path / parent-child tree data support via AG Grid's `treeData` API
- `RowGroupingConfig` — field-based row grouping with aggregation functions
- `ExcelExportConfig` — Excel-compatible CSV export with toolbar button and context menu item

## Reporting Engine (`plugin-report`)

- **`ReportExportEngine.ts`** — browser-native export to PDF (print dialog), Excel (BOM+TSV), CSV, JSON, HTML. No heavy dependencies.
- **`ScheduleConfig.tsx`** — frequency/day/time/timezone/recipients configuration component
- Wired export buttons (PDF/Excel/CSV) into `ReportViewer`, added Schedule tab to `ReportBuilder`

## Workflow Engine (`plugin-workflow`) — new package

- **`WorkflowDesigner`** — visual flow builder with 9 node types, node palette, properties panel, edge management
- **`ApprovalProcess`** — approve/reject/reassign UI with history timeline and rule display
- 10 tests across 2 suites

## AI Integration (`plugin-ai`) — new package

- **`AIFormAssist`** — field suggestion cards with confidence scores, apply/dismiss, batch apply
- **`AIRecommendations`** — scored item recommendations in list or grid layout
- **`NLQueryInput`** — natural language query input with suggestion chips, result table, query history
- 14 tests across 3 suites

## Security

- `escapeHTML()` for XSS prevention in generated HTML/PDF
- `sanitizeCSVValue()` — prefixes formula chars (`=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, `|`) with tab to prevent CSV injection
- `validatePageSize()` / `validateOrientation()` — whitelist validation against CSS injection in `@page` rules

```typescript
// New component registration pattern
ComponentRegistry.register('workflow-designer', WorkflowDesigner, {
  label: 'Workflow Designer',
  category: 'Enterprise',
  inputs: [
    { name: 'workflow', type: 'code', label: 'Initial Workflow Definition' },
    { name: 'readOnly', type: 'boolean', label: 'Read Only', defaultValue: false },
  ]
});
```

**Note:** Pre-existing test failures from `plugin-dashboard`'s `WidthProvider` import in the global vitest setup are unrelated to these changes.
